facts.business: S. M. Gold Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and wholesale trading of gold mangalsutra jewellery and a diverse range of gold jewellery including rings, chains, earrings, and wedding jewellery.

segments.name: Gold Jewellery Manufacturing and Wholesale Trading

key_risks: Dependence on skilled artisans and job workers
Regulatory changes in hallmarking and compliance
Competition from organized and unorganized players
Economic downturns affecting discretionary spending on jewellery
facts.related_party_note: The Company acquired the business of the proprietorship concern of promoter Mr. Priyank S. Shah (M/s. S. M. Gold) through a Business Succession Agreement dated August 03, 2018. The Company also outsources manufacturing to job workers in Ahmedabad, Rajkot, Kolkata, and Mumbai without formal agreements, based on long-standing relationships.
